To sign up for or purchase a paid plan for Mailchimp, you can choose from their tiered subscription options directly through the Mailchimp Pricing Plans Page[Mailchimp Pricing Plans Page](https://mailchimp.com/pricing/marketing/).[[1]](https://mailchimp.com/pricing/marketing/)

#### Mailchimp Tier Overview

- **Free Plan** : Ideal for getting started (0/mo 0 / mo 0/m o , limited to 250 contacts and 500 email sends/month).
- **Essentials** : Best for occasional email senders requiring basic email templates, custom branding, and 24/7 support.
- **Standard** : Most popular for growing businesses, starting at **20/month 20 / month𝟐𝟎/𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐡** (or **17/month 17 / month𝟏𝟕/𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐡** for the first 12 months), featuring advanced automation, customer journey builder, and predictive segmentation.
- **Premium** : Built for high-volume senders and larger teams, offering unlimited audiences, phone support, and multivariate testing.[[1]](https://mailchimp.com/pricing/marketing/)

#### How to Buy / Sign Up

1. Go to the official Mailchimp Pricing & Plans[Mailchimp Pricing & Plans](https://mailchimp.com/pricing/marketing/).
2. Select your desired tier (**Free**, **Essentials**, **Standard** , or **Premium**).
3. Adjust the slider for your **estimated number of contacts** to view the exact price for your list size.
4. Click **Buy Now** or **Sign Up** to create your account and complete the checkout process with your billing information.[[1]](https://mailchimp.com/pricing/marketing/)

If you'd like, let me know:

- **Roughly how many contacts** you have in your list
- **What features** you need most (like automation, landing pages, or SMS marketing)

I can help you pick the **best-fitting plan** or check if you qualify for any introductory deals.
